summary: SnappyMail is a self-hosted PHP webmail client: it authenticates against external IMAP/SMTP/Sieve/CardDAV servers and persists its own accounts, domains, contacts, settings, filter scripts and encryption keys. There are two realms behind one surface: mail users (sign_in for contacts, additional accounts, identities, settings and filter scripts) and the admin panel (sign_in_admin for domains and global config). All client state is stored as JSON blobs keyed by the account email; the admin tools are the only globally-scoped surface.
